about_the_game:
Succubus: The Lustborn Curse is a lewd 2.5D action Metroidvania and an immersive H Game where you take control of a fallen succubus on a dark, erotic journey to reclaim her stolen powers.

After a failed attempt to seduce a powerful priest, you’ve been cursed, stripped of your abilities, and left weakened. Now, trapped in a corrupted realm, you must fight, seduce, and dominate your way through twisted creatures and forgotten temples to regain your strength.

Key Features

Seductive Hack-and-Slash Combat

Wield dual blades, ranged magic, and devastating finishers in fast-paced combat.

[GIF of 3-hit combo]

Lewd Abilities as Core Mechanics

lewd content isn't just fanservice, it's a central part of the gameplay loop. As a cursed succubus, your primary source of power comes from seducing & draining essence through erotic encounters. These animated H-scenes restore your MP, unlock new powers, and even act as gates to progression, making lust a key mechanic, not a side attraction.

Full NSFW & Lewd Animations

Beyond the tight combat and fast-paced lewd abilities, Succubus: The Lustborn Curse offers a fully animated, uncensored adult experience.

Every erotic encounter — from finishers to altars to story scenes — features high-quality lewd animations and cutscenes, crafted to enhance both immersion and indulgence. Whether you're looking for pleasure, power, or both... this game delivers.
[GIF of adult finisher with red demon]

A Dark & Sinful Story

Step into a twisted world of lust and corruption, where forbidden magic and seductive power collide.

The story unfolds as you explore, seduce, and conquer - with dialogue, encounters, and lewd cutscenes that reveal more of the succubus’s curse and the dark forces behind it.

Expect a mature narrative filled with mystery, sin, and revenge, woven seamlessly into both the combat and erotic progression

Metroidvania Exploration

Discover an interconnected world with shortcuts, secrets, and ability-gated zones. Unlock new movement and magic to explore deeper.
[GIF of double jump or magnet-based traversal]

Your Journey Awaits

Whether you're here for the combat, the kink, or the exploration — Succubus: The Lustborn Curse is your gateway to a dark, sexy fantasy full of danger, pleasure, and secrets. The game is in active development with regular updates, new abilities, and ever-expanding NSFW content.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game features explicit sexual scenes including full nudity, fantasy-themed seduction, and animated intercourse with fantasy creatures. All sexual interactions are depicted as consensual and are part of a supernatural, erotic setting. Players will encounter options to seduce enemies using  seductive abilities and magic.

The game also contains stylized combat with moderate fantasy violence (non-realistic blood effects), occasional mature language, and light BDSM/kink themes. There are no depictions of sexual violence.
